messages:
marco: quick RFC follow-up: thinking about a pragmatic pin-token that is tiny (~60-80 bytes) and verifiable. Goal: reduce hot-KV memory while keeping full-manifest audit in object storage. reactions?

elaine: sounds good. main tradeoffs: how much routing semantics do we bake in vs keep in routing service? smaller token = faster, but we lose expressivity.

tom: runtime note: for the hot path the resolver only needs [model_hash, epoch, rollout_tag, fallback_id, expiry]. If token packs only those plus a short sig we can avoid manifest fetch 99% of the time.

marco: proposal sketch: token = PTK2.<b64(payload)>.sig where payload is binary-packed fields: tenant_varint, model_hash(20B), epoch_varint, rollout_tag_varint, expiry(4B opt), flags(1B). sig = HMAC-SHA256(key, payload) truncated to 8B. final ~56-72 bytes.

ops-lee: ops: agree on size win. migration: dual-write index value = {"token":"PTK2...","manifest_url":"s3://...","manifest_hash":"sha256:..."} so older resolvers continue to fetch manifest. new resolvers prefer token-first. Keep manifest in object store for audits.

elaine: observability: compact token is opaque. Add control-plane cache token->expanded fields for traces and Console debug. Also emit token_verification_fail and token_fallback_to_manifest metrics.

tom: security: truncated HMAC is ok if we rotate keys and can blacklist hot tokens. For emergency retirements publish small denylist via push to resolvers to avoid per-request blacklist checks.

signer-bot: snapshot created: control-plane/rollout-token/5987654321

marco: action items: (1) tom: resolver PR to accept PTK2 and verify sig (ETA 1w) (2) ops-lee: migration playbook + canary gating thresholds (ETA 3d) (3) elaine: Console debug UX + trace inclusion (ETA 1w) (4) tom/ops: spec for denylist push channel and key rotation (ETA 4d).

elaine: quick question: do we include rollout weights in token? I prefer no, keep weights in routing table referenced by rollout_tag to allow retargeting without repinning.

marco: agreed. rollout_tag references routing policy. token stays minimal. We'll sync Thursday to review PRs. :thumbsup:
